Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instrumentation and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.

It was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality of the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.

rows: Test the input and output voltages of the power supply and check that they are as follows: Input: 220 V AC. Output: (+ 12, + 5.15, 5.1, - 48) Vdc
Isolate the power supply feeding the cards
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray
Test the cables of each line
Clean the junction boxes collecting the cables with a blower
If a cable is found damaged, replace it with a new cable
Measure the line voltage and check that it is -48 V DC, via the terminal block in the box
If there is no -48 V DC, perform a reset via the CPU 545 card
If there is still no -48 V DC after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings.

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Communications Equipment | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: PCS-002-r0a | Equipment: BCN 5200 Alcatel telephone communications equipment
Issued to: Talkha Combined Cycle
Status: Approved
Approval date: 13 March 2006 | Procedure: Annual calibration (I1-Y1)
Next review date: March 2011
This document sets out the calibration steps
The system consists of:
+ 5.15, - 5.1, + 12, -48 Vdc power supply unit
6 control cards
Interface card
Capacity 90 lines (26 lines in use)
4 junction boxes
+ 5.15, - 5.1, + 12, -48 Vdc power supply unit
6 control cards
Interface card
Capacity 90 lines (26 lines in use)
4 junction boxes
The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Wagdy Eid Mansour, tested by Eng. Taher Abdel Galil El-Khatib, approved by the General Manager Eng. Yousry Ahmed Abdel Maksoud, reviewed by Eng. Abdel Monem El-Emam, Manager of the Instrumentation and Electricity Department in the Inspection Sector of the East Delta Electricity Production Company, and approved by Eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab, Head of the Talkha Power Station Sector.
It was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality of the East Delta Electricity Production Company and MPIS Coordinator, and approved by Mr. Accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, General Manager of Financial and Administrative Control and Supervisor of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work permit, with an industrial safety category card available for the personnel on site
Fence off the area, using the appropriate warning signs
Use personal protective equipment (PPE) such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Notify all users to close the telephone lines during the maintenance work

Fence off the area, using the appropriate warning signs
Use personal protective equipment (PPE) such as a safety helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Notify all users to close the telephone lines during the maintenance work
Suitable tool bag, personal protective equipment (PPE)
Digital voltmeter, Fluk 187
Complete tool bag
Dry air blower
Contact cleaning spray
Suitable tool bag, personal protective equipment (PPE)
Digital voltmeter, Fluk 187
Complete tool bag
Dry air blower
Contact cleaning spray
Procedures to be Carried Out
Test the input and output voltages of the power supply and check that they are as follows: Input: 220 V AC. Output: (+ 12, + 5.15, 5.1, - 48) Vdc | 1.
Isolate the power supply feeding the cards | 2.
Remove the system cards and clean the bases with spray | 3.
Reinsert the cards | 4.
Test the cables of each line | 5.
Clean the junction boxes collecting the cables with a blower | 6.
If a cable is found damaged, replace it with a new cable | 7.
Reconnect the power supply | 8.
Measure the line voltage and check that it is -48 V DC, via the terminal block in the box | 9.
If there is no -48 V DC, perform a reset via the CPU 545 card | 10.
If there is still no -48 V DC after the reset, follow up the repair using the relevant drawings. | 11.
